note: Public vocabularies behind the name tier. No word is added by hand and nothing is read from the evaluation fixtures.
fold: NFKD, remove combining marks, lowercase, keep a to z only (src/text-fold.js)

census2010.title: US Census Bureau, Frequently Occurring Surnames from the 2010 Census (Names_2010Census.csv)
census2010.use: Surnames that occur 100 or more times, and separately those that occur 1,000 or more times

female.title: US Census Bureau, 1990 Census female first names (dist.female.first)

male.title: US Census Bureau, 1990 Census male first names (dist.male.first)

fda.title: US FDA, Drugs@FDA data files, Products.txt (DrugName and ActiveIngredient columns)
fda.use: Drug brand names and active ingredients

icd.title: CMS, ICD-10-CM 2025 code descriptions in tabular order (icd10cm_codes_2025.txt)

english.title: Webster's Second International word list (web2, as distributed in BSD and macOS /usr/share/dict)
english.license: Public domain (the 1934 copyright has lapsed, per the distribution README)
english.use: Lowercase entries as ordinary English words. Capitalized entries ending in -an, -ese, -ish, -ic or -i as proper adjectives (nationalities, languages, peoples)
